correctness.rationale: The palindrome factor cap is one traversal of the circle. Two runs yield n+floor(a/2)+floor(b/2). Four runs have only palindromes of one, three or five symbol runs; enumerating center run and full flanking blocks gives four exact cases. Parity of unequal opposite runs yields equality counts; rotation maps ordered quadruples in two-element orbits for equality tuples. A known six-run family attains 10t-2 for n=6t and beats the bound for t>=3. Independent definition-level enumeration verified 1,001 ordered positive four-run compositions with n<=14, and t=2..8 six-run witnesses. Proof, not samples, supports every length.
